name: CDC Fyshwick 1 (FY1)

address.value: 2 Leonora Street, Fyshwick ACT 2609 (Block 6 Section 85 Fyshwick)
address.note: probable FY1 building address: A+P Leemhuis (FY1 builder) describes '12,000 m2 on a 12,000 m2 block'; ACT cadastre Block 6 Sec 85 (2 Leonora St) is 12,564 sqm and adjoins Block 7 Sec 85 (11 Tom Price St, 12,292 sqm); Master Builders award text refers to CDC building at 2 Leonora St; OSM names the 11 Tom Price St building 'Fyshwick 2'. CDC/DCM give the campus address as 11 Tom Price Street

lat.note: Changed 2026-09-27 to the centroid of ACT cadastre Block 6 Section 85 Fyshwick (2 Leonora St) from ACTmapi ACTGOV_BLOCKS (outSR=4326), because FY1 appears to be on that block. Previous value -35.33804,149.18315 was the ArcGIS geocode of the campus address 11 Tom Price St (Block 7, the FY2 building), ~60 m away

builder.note: builder's project page: 'Construction of a new purpose built data storage facility for CDC Data Centres. It was the first TIA-942 approved facility in Australia'; supervised all trades

mw_it.note: 'one Fyshwick facility with 18 MW capacity' (GovTechReview/iTWire/Canberra Times Aug 2017); CDC lists Fyshwick campus FY1+FY2 at 45 MW operating

cost_aud_m.note: A+P Leemhuis project page lists '$110M' - builder's project value, not confirmed as total capex

pathway.value: Development application (ACT Planning and Development Act 2007)

reference.note: probable, not confirmed: ACT completed-DA register shows DA 201323908 on Block 6 Sec 85 Fyshwick (subclasses commercial, industrial, design and siting, consolidating land, lease variation); proposal text and notice of decision not retrieved. CDC says FY1 construction commenced 2013. An earlier DA 201221350 (2012) was on adjoining Block 7

construction_start.note: CDC About us timeline: '2013 Fyshwick campus - Construction of FY1 commences'

construction_end.note: CDC Mar 2026 investor presentation timeline: '2015 Fyshwick - Fyshwick 1 becomes operational'. Earlier search snippet said January 2014; either way before the 2018-09-01 cutoff

open_questions: scope: excluded - completed before 2016-01-01 (operational 2015 per CDC Mar 2026 deck; Jan 2014 per earlier report); removed from master.csv and listed in excluded.csv (decision 2026-09-27)
